description: Recover one already-uploaded workflow after exactpdf_workflow_submit reports finalization_pending. It authenticates POST /api/v1/workflow-jobs/:upload_id and never creates an intent, re-uploads bytes, or exposes a GCS session URL. Call workflow status first; use this once only while the upload remains uploading. A queued/already-queued/in-progress result belongs to the original job and may consume that job’s normal budget only after verified output. Stop on rejected or expired uploads; do not submit a replacement without explicit approval.

upload_id.description: UUID returned as upload_id by workflow_finalize_recoverable.

name: exactpdf_workflow_finalize
